Maya Kline: CI is red on PR #2483 — integration/db flaked on 'connection_timeout' twice. CI Bot points to node-3. Should we do a full rebuild or just a targeted rerun? I want to avoid rebuilding images if possible.

CI Bot: Build report: PR 2483 — job 'integration/db' failed (exit 1) on node-3. Retry count: 0. https://ci.redwood.example/builds/2483 :warning:

Alex Chen: If it's the same flaky test and nothing in the Dockerfile changed, prefer a targeted rerun with skip-image. Use the rw-ci helper: 
```
rw-ci rerun --pr 2483 --job integration/db --skip-image
```

Sasha Ortiz: Another low-cost try is to restart just the worker process on the failing node (no rerun of the entire job):
```
rwci restart-worker --job integration/db --node node-3 --attempt 1
```

Jamie Park: If it flakes repeatedly, we should bisect locally (seed the test) before escalating. Otherwise go ahead with one targeted rerun. @Maya want me to kick it off?

Maya Kline: :thumbsup: Yes please, go ahead and rerun once. I'll tail the logs and grab artifacts if it fails again.

CI Bot: Command recorded: `rw-ci rerun --pr 2483 --job integration/db --skip-image` executed by Jamie Park. Rerun started: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/2483/rerun/1 :rocket:
